clips.title: The story
paras: In Brill's Gallows' End Tavern, Coleman Farthing nurses a hatred born in the Agamand Mills. He served the wealthy Agamand dynasty in northern Tirisfal, where he and the other laborers died defending their employers' estate from the Scourge. Now Forsaken, he seeks vengeance on his former masters.

Before the Third War, Coleman Farthing worked at the Agamand Mills, Tirisfal Glades' largest milling and agricultural operation. When the Scourge swept across Lordaeron, the aristocratic Agamand family refused to flee their valuable lands. They urged their household and laborers to take up arms, promising they could hold the farmsteads against the undead horde. Coleman and his fellow workers stayed, believing their masters. Every last one of them died.

Coleman Farthing broke free into the Forsaken after being raised into undeath, and he still hates the Agamands. He blames his former employers' greed and pride for tricking their staff into an impossible last stand, not only the Scourge. From a tavern in Brill, he sends Horde champions to the blighted mills to kill the risen Agamand kin and plunder heirloom weapons from their family crypt, stripping away the last of their honor.
